newsitem.title: ITALY: Telecom Italia names merger advisors.
newsitem.headline: Telecom Italia names merger advisors.

text.p: The board of Telecom Italia said on Thursday that it appointed credit institute IMI Spa Istituto Mobiliare Italiano and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell to evaluate state telecoms group Stet and Telecom and recommend the appropriate share swap ratio.
Stet and Telecom are to merge ahead of the group's planned privatisation, with Telecom incorporated into Stet and the new entity named Telecom Italia.

Stet said in a statement earlier that its board named JP Morgan and Giubergia Warburg as the Stet advisors. Both companies said Price Waterhouse had been asked to arbitrate in the event that their respective advisers fail to agree.
